messages:
sophie (sales): FYI ACME POC reports their free credits plunged to 0 mid-demo and the app hit 429s. They insist we granted $5k. Can we swarm? @maria (solutions) @raj (billing) :eyes:

acme-poc-admin: We started a streaming demo ~11:10 PST. Console showed $5k, 2 mins later UI said 0 and SDK got 429 Rate limit exceeded. No config changes on our side. request id: 01F8XYZ

maria (solutions): Can you drop org_id and a sample request_id here? Also which model/endpoint?

acme-poc-admin: org_8823, request 01F8XYZ, endpoint /v1/generate model rdl-large-v1. Raw response: {"error":"Rate limit exceeded","code":429} (copied from client)

ingrid (support): I'm pulling activity for org_8823 11:09-11:15. Running log query now. Can you confirm if your client has automatic retries turned on?

acme-poc-admin: We're using the JS SDK default retries. Didn't think they'd fire that quickly during streaming.

alex (eng): Looking into logs — I see duplicate request_ids arriving ~400ms apart for the same stream session. Both are being counted toward usage. Suspect SDK retry + our duplicate-detection TTL gap.

raj (billing): Quick primer: free credits are applied as a billing balance. The usage meter shows raw token usage; the "available credits" widget updates asynchronously (reconcile runs nightly + near-real-time adjustments). That said, an instantaneous drop to 0 is unusual. Could be double-counting.

maria (solutions): Temporary mitigation: disable retries in client or flip to `stream: false` to avoid multiple parallel connections. Also we can push a billing override so demo doesn't block. @raj can you approve a short-term override?

raj (billing): I can apply a $1,000 temporary override for org_8823 — doing that now. Opening billing ticket B-1746 and tagging finance. Will confirm when applied.

ingrid (support): Log snippet (sanitized): ```json
{
  "ts": "2026-03-21T18:10:12Z",
  "org": "org_8823",
  "request_id": "01F8XYZ",
  "event": "generation.request",
  "status": "received"
}
{
  "ts": "2026-03-21T18:10:12Z",
  "org": "org_8823",
  "request_id": "01F8XYZ",
  "event": "generation.request",
  "status": "received"
}
``` Two entries with same id in <1s window.

alex (eng): That matches what I see. Root cause: client-side immediate retry + our dedupe TTL (500ms) allowed both attempts to be processed, resulting in double token accounting for streaming chunks. I'll draft a fix to key by connection fingerprint and extend dedupe window for streaming.

maria (solutions): For the customer: please disable retries for the demo and restart the session. That should stop the sudden burn. We'll follow with a permanent server-side fix.

acme-poc-admin: Disabled retries, restarted — demo resumed and credits stopped dropping. Thanks. Can you share a short RCA and timeline we can send to our finance team?

raj (billing): I'll include the billing override note and ticket B-1746 in the response.

alex (eng): I'll post a brief RCA here once I open the PR (adding idempotency fingerprint + longer TTL for streaming). ETA 24h for patch + staged rollout.

sophie (sales): Awesome — tagging this resolved for the demo. Please paste the RCA + billing ticket link when available so I can follow up with ACME. :thumbsup:
